basic_details.job_title: IIT Ropar Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Ropar (IIT Ropar) has released the IIT Ropar Research Associate Recruitment 2026 notification for 1 Research Associate vacancy in the Department of Physics under the ANRF PAIR DEARMS initiative. Candidates with a Ph.D. in Physics, Materials Science, Chemistry, Computational Materials Science, Nanoscience, or related engineering disciplines are eligible to apply. The selected candidate will receive Rs 58,000 per month, plus HRA if applicable. Eligible candidates can apply via email by submitting the required documents on or before 28 October 2026.

qualification.details: Ph.D. in Physics, Materials Science, Chemistry, Computational Materials Science, Nanoscience, or related engineering disciplines.

how_to_apply: Prepare a single PDF file containing a one-page cover letter describing your background and prior research knowledge.
Include your resume with complete qualification and experience, soft copies of all degree and marksheet certificates, and certificates of your PhD degree and GATE/NET qualification.
Attach recommendation letters from two referees and a list of publications within the same PDF.
Name the single PDF file strictly as: RA_ANRF Project_Your name.
Email the compiled PDF to [email protected] and cc it to [email protected] (Dr. Vivekanand Shukla) on or before 28/10/2026.

content_sections.heading: IIT Ropar Research Associate at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Ropar (IIT Ropar)
Initially for one year, extendable up to 2 years based on satisfactory performance

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the essential qualifications from a recognized University/Institute to apply for the IIT Ropar Research Associate recruitment. Ph.D. in Physics, Materials Science, Chemistry, Computational Materials Science, Nanoscience, or related engineering disciplines. Strong background in density functional theory (DFT), molecular dynamics simulations, or machine learning for materials discovery. Proven track record in energy storage/conversion materials (batteries, hydrogen storage, electrocatalysis) or high-pressure materials physics. Prior publication record in high-impact peer-reviewed scientific journals.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs 58,000 per month, with HRA if applicable. The position is full-time on a contract basis, initially for one year, and may be extended up to 2 years based on satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: IIT Ropar Research Associate Job Description
content_sections.text: The Research Associate will work under the direct guidance of Prof. Rajeev Ahuja on an advanced interdisciplinary research project focusing on Computational Materials Science, Energy Materials (Batteries, Hydrogen Storage & Production, Sensors), and High-Pressure Physics. Key responsibilities include: Perform high-level computational modeling and simulation of advanced materials for energy applications. Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams under the ANRF PAIR initiative. Prepare research reports, present findings at international forums, and handle manuscript drafting for top-tier peer-reviewed journals.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Ropar Research Associate
content_sections.text: Prepare a single PDF file containing a one-page cover letter describing your background and prior research knowledge. Include your resume with complete qualification and experience, soft copies of all degree and marksheet certificates, and certificates of your PhD degree and GATE/NET qualification. Attach recommendation letters from two referees and a list of publications within the same PDF. Name the single PDF file strictly as: RA_ANRF Project_Your name . Email the compiled PDF to [email protected] and cc it to [email protected] (Dr. Vivekanand Shukla) on or before 28/10/2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an online interview through email.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the IIT Ropar Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: There is exactly 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit applications?
faq.answer: The last date to email applications is 28/10/2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Ph.D. in Physics, Materials Science, Chemistry, Computational Materials Science, Nanoscience, or related engineering disciplines. Q4. Is there an upper age limit for applicants? Yes, the upper age limit is 35 years. Q5. What salary will be provided to the selected Research Associate? A salary of Rs 58,000 per month will be provided, along with HRA if applicable. Q6. What is the application fee? The notification does not mention any application fee. Q7. Is this position permanent or on contract? The position is full-time on a contract basis, initially for one year and extendable up to 2 years based on satisfactory performance. Q8. How should applications be submitted? Applications must be emailed as a single PDF named RA_ANRF Project_Your name to [email protected] with a cc to [email protected]. Q9. What selection process will be followed? Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an online interview through email.
